say:1:1322244001:1.text: Yes! Finally, all the evil cultists have been defeated!
say:1:1322244001:1.source_cn: 这些邪恶的邪教徒总算被消灭啦！

say:2:1322244002:1.text: Fortunately, we stopped them in the nick of time. Otherwise, it would've been a huge disaster.
say:2:1322244002:1.source_cn: 还好及时阻止，没有让他们酿出大祸。

say:3:1322244003:1.text: The magic circle is gone, but the undead are still coming toward us!
say:3:1322244003:1.source_cn: 法阵消失了，可是这些活死人怎么朝着我们过来了？！

choice_prompt:4:1322244003.text: The magic circle is gone, but the undead are still coming toward us!
choice_prompt:4:1322244003.source_cn: 法阵消失了，可是这些活死人怎么朝着我们过来了？！

say:5:1322244004:1.text: The magister is right. Even if they haven't turned into Hypofiends, their souls are still suffering.
say:5:1322244004:1.source_cn: 主人说得对，就算没有变成魔物，他们现在的灵魂也饱受煎熬。
say:5:1322244004:1.male: The magister is right. Even if they haven't turned into Hypofiends, their souls are still suffering.
say:5:1322244004:1.female: The magister is right. Even if they haven't turned into Hypofiends, their souls are still suffering.

choice:4:0:1.text: We have to put them out of their misery.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 看来只有让他们彻底解脱了
choice:4:0:1.male: We have to put them out of their misery.
choice:4:0:1.female: We have to put them out of their misery.
